name: prefer-builtin-tools
description: Turns back simple Bash commands (cat, head, tail, grep, rg, find, sed -i, echo > file) whose job Read, Grep, Glob, Edit or Write does better, naming the tool to use

read.title: cat / head / tail / sed -n → Read
read.description: Turn back reading one file with cat, head, tail or sed -n and point to the Read tool.

grep.title: grep / rg → Grep
grep.description: Turn back searching file contents with grep, egrep or rg and point to the Grep tool.

glob.title: find -name → Glob
glob.description: Turn back finding files by name with find and point to the Glob tool.

edit.title: sed -i → Edit
edit.description: Turn back a literal sed -i substitution in one file and point to the Edit tool.

write.title: echo / cat heredoc > file → Write
write.description: Turn back writing a file with echo > file or a cat heredoc and point to the Write tool.

enforceInBypass.title: Also in bypass-permissions mode
enforceInBypass.description: Keep turning commands back in bypass-permissions mode, whose system prompt tells Claude it may read, search and edit through Bash.
